_note: Mock fixture. Values summarized from the public Hilti system drawing W-L-5143 (Dec 18, 2025).

pages.text: System No. W-L-5143. F Ratings 1 and 2 hr. T Rating 1/2 hr. Copper pipe or tube up to 1 in with foam insulation through gypsum wall. Hilti FS-ONE MAX sealant. Tested to ANSI/UL1479 (ASTM E814).

claims.quote: Copper pipe or tube up to 1 in with foam insulation

extract.https://www.hilti.com/media-canonical/AS: System No. W-L-5143, December 18, 2025. F Ratings 1 and 2 hr, T Rating 1/2 hr.

report.summary: The firestop system's temperature rating is lower than its fire rating, which this project's spec does not allow.
report.note_to_subcontractor: Please resubmit with a listed system whose T rating equals its F rating for this wall, as required by spec section 07 84 00.

finding_titles.spec-fs-t-eq-f: Temperature rating is lower than the fire rating
finding_titles.spec-fs-voc: VOC content isn't stated on the system drawing

why_it_matters.spec-fs-t-eq-f: This school's standard requires the T rating to match the F rating, so heat can't pass through the wall for as long as fire is held back.
